name: Clap Between
description: Puts a clap emoji between every word.
legacyScript:
function cp(n){ if(n<0x10000) return String.fromCharCode(n); n-=0x10000; return String.fromCharCode(0xD800+(n>>10),0xDC00+(n&0x3FF)); }
        function animate(env,el,p){ el.text=el.text.trim().split(/\s+/).join(" "+cp(0x1F44F)+" "); return el; }
